async def act(page):
    # Locate the row for the home page by filtering for the cell with text 'Madison Island'
    home_page_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Madison Island'))
    # Within that row, get the cell with 'Madison Island' (which is a link) and click it
    madison_island_cell = home_page_row.get_by_role('cell', name='Madison Island')
    madison_island_link = madison_island_cell.get_by_role('link')
    await madison_island_link.click()
    # Wait for the edit page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    return
